document.title: Request for Application to Serve as Observer Groups for 2027 General Election
document.description: How observer groups apply and are accredited for the 2027 general election, including the application deadline.

chunks.text:
REQUEST FOR APPLICATION TO SERVE AS OBSERVER GROUPS FOR

2027 GENERAL ELECTION

The Independent National Eelectoral Commission (INEC) hereby invites registered Civil Society

Organizations (CSOs), Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs), Diplomatic Corps and other

stakeholders whose work is on democracy, governance and election wishing to observe the

Nigeria 2027 General elections scheduled to hold on 16thJanuary (national election) and 6

th

February 2027 (state election) to visit (http://observergroups.inecnigeria.org) and apply. This

is without prejudice to any previous correspondence with the Commission.

2. Observer groups are to submit information including legal status (registration with CAC

or other relevant Agency), evidence of registration with the Civil Society Desk at INEC

Headquarters, evidence of previous election observations with INEC (if any) and

acknowledgment page of submission of reports of election observation (if any), With the

completed form EC14A(I)
3. The deadline for submission of application (Form EC14A (1)) is 26TH October, 2026. The

list of successful observer groups approved for accreditation will be published.

4. Any falsification of documents in the submissions will lead to automatic disqualification

and possible prosecution.

ACCREDITATION OF SUCCESSFUL OBSERVER GROUPS
5. Each successful group would be required to complete the online deployment of field

observers' Form (EC14A (ii)) and submit same.

6. Successful observer groups should also note that in order to enable the Commission

produce identification/accreditation tags for deployed field observers, passport photographs of

the field observers to be deployed to the field should be arranged on Local Government Area

(LGA) basis, in JPEG Format.

7. NOTE ON ELECTION OBSERVATION EXERCISE

Observer groups should note that the core principle of election observation in line with best

practices, would guide the conduct of field observers during the election. These include

impartiality, objectivity and non-partisanship.

Please be guided accordingly.

SIGNED: INDEPENDENT NATIONAL ELECTORAL COMMISSION (INEC)
